decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: The observation reads the derived stackstall ActionGroup and its six children through the Action executor members (count/lcount/count_tests/count_apply/status, action.hh:80-87) plus the IR (PcodeOp opcode/SeqNum order/dead flag, Varnode in/wr/spacebase flags); ActionGroup::apply mutates the group's count (action.cc:515-516) and drives each child's perform.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: The external mirror walks action.cc:303-350's do-while exactly: per pass one ActionGroup::apply sweeping children in list order (vector begin()->end(), action.cc:513), lcount snapshotted before apply (cc:314), loop continues only while lcount<count AND rule_repeatapply (cc:350); the group-level count_tests/count_apply accumulate across the two runs exactly as the persistent Action members would.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: count resets to 0 at each run's status_start visit (cc:306), accumulates children's perform returns within a pass and across passes of one run; count_tests increments once per run (cc:311), count_apply increments when lcount<count (cc:327-329); ActionGroup::reset (action.cc:408-415) resets child status but NOT the counters, and ActionStackPtrFlow::reset clears analysis_finished (coreaction.hh:99) so run 2 re-analyzes.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: No sorting; child order is the registration order of universalAction (coreaction.cc:5511-5656); IR projection order is op/varnode creation order; the fixed-point exit test is the scalar lcount<count comparison.
